title: Are We Aligned? A Preliminary Investigation of the Alignment of Responsible AI Values between LLMs and Human Judgment
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It focused on the alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) with human judgments on responsible AI values, such as fairness, privacy, transparency, safety, and accountability, within secular contexts like medicine, banking, marketing, and streaming.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on general responsible AI values in secular domains.
